name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
nodal_body: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, GoI

annual_benefit.value: ₹6,000 per year in three equal instalments of ₹2,000 directly transferred to bank accounts.

ekyc_mandatory.value: e-KYC is mandatory for all PM-KISAN registered farmers. OTP-based e-KYC available on PMKISAN Portal or biometric at nearest CSC centres.

landholding_eligibility.value: All landholding farmer families with cultivable land in their names are eligible (institutional landholders and defined exclusion criteria apply).

land_cut_off_date.value: Land ownership transfer cut-off date is 01-02-2019. Land acquired after this date is subject to physical verification (exceptions for inheritance upon death of landowner).

latest_instalment.value: Official portal lists 22nd instalment released 13 Mar 2026; secondary news reported 23rd instalment in Jun 2026.

documents: Aadhaar Card linked with active bank account
Landholding records (7/12 extract / 8A extract in Maharashtra)
Bank Account details with active DBT
steps: Verify Aadhaar and complete biometric / OTP e-KYC
Ensure land records are linked with your PM-KISAN beneficiary status

summary_mr.text: शेतकरी कुटुंबांसाठी वार्षिक ₹६,००० चे उत्पन्न सहाय्य (३ समान हप्त्यांमध्ये). ई-केवायसी आणि बँक खात्याशी आधार जोडणी अनिवार्य आहे.

summary_hi.text: पात्र किसान परिवारों को प्रति वर्ष ₹6,000 की वित्तीय सहायता (3 किस्तों में)। ई-केवाईसी और बैंक खाते से आधार लिंक होना अनिवार्य है।

name: Namo Shetkari Mahasanman Nidhi Yojana (NSMNY)
nodal_body: Department of Agriculture, Government of Maharashtra

annual_benefit.value: Government of Maharashtra provides ₹6,000 per year (3 instalments of ₹2,000). A news wire cited proposal for increase to ₹9,000 (unresolved GR).

link_to_pmkisan.value: Beneficiaries must be actively approved and registered under PM-KISAN in Maharashtra. No separate registration required.

steps: Ensure eligibility and approval under PM-KISAN
Verify Aadhaar seeding status with Maharashtra agriculture department database

summary_mr.text: महाराष्ट्र शासनातर्फे पीएम-किसान लाभार्थ्यांना अतिरिक्त ₹६,००० वार्षिक सहाय्य थेट बँक खात्यात.

summary_hi.text: महाराष्ट्र सरकार द्वारा पीएम-किसान लाभार्थियों को प्रति वर्ष ₹6,000 की अतिरिक्त सहायता।

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
nodal_body: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, GoI / State Dept of Agriculture

farmer_premium_share.value: Standard farmer premium share: Kharif food/oilseeds 2%, Rabi food/oilseeds 1.5%, Commercial / Horticultural crops 5% of sum insured.

maharashtra_one_rupee_model.value: The earlier ₹1 token premium scheme in Maharashtra was discontinued in 2025; standard state operational guidelines apply.

rabi_cutoff_date.value: Enrolment cut-off date is notified by the state government for each notified crop and district. Indicative cut-off is 15 Dec - 31 Dec.

calamity_intimation.value: Crop loss due to localized calamity or post-harvest loss must be reported within 72 hours via Crop Insurance App or helpline 14447.

documents: Sowing Certificate / Declaration from Gram Panchayat or Patwari
steps: Confirm if your crop and village are notified for the current season
Apply via Bank, CSC Center, or PMFBY portal before the season deadline
Save acknowledgment receipt and insurance policy copy

summary_mr.text: नैसर्गिक आपत्तींमुळे पिकांचे नुकसान झाल्यास व्यापक विमा संरक्षण. रब्बी पिकांसाठी १.५% व खरीप पिकांसाठी २% शेतकरी प्रीमियम हिस्सा.

summary_hi.text: फसल नुकसान की स्थिति में वित्तीय सुरक्षा। रबी फसलों के लिए 1.5% और खरीफ फसलों के लिए 2% किसान प्रीमियम हिस्सा।

name: Per Drop More Crop (Micro-Irrigation) — Maharashtra
name_mr: प्रति थेंब अधिक पीक (सूक्ष्म सिंचन) — महाराष्ट्र
name_hi: प्रति बूंद अधिक फसल (सूक्ष्म सिंचाई) — महाराष्ट्र

parent_scheme.value: Operated under PM-RKVY (earlier under PMKSY). Provides subsidy for drip and sprinkler irrigation.

application_route.value: Online application mandatory through Maharashtra MahaDBT Farmer Schemes portal.

documents: 7/12 extract showing water source / well / borewell
steps: Upload quotations and await lottery / pre-sanction letter

summary_mr.text: ठिबक व तुषार सिंचन पद्धतीसाठी शासकीय अनुदान. महाडीबीटी पोर्टलद्वारे अर्ज करणे आवश्यक.

summary_hi.text: ड्रिप और स्प्रिंकलर सिंचाई प्रणाली पर सरकारी सब्सिडी। महाडीबीटी पोर्टल के माध्यम से आवेदन।

name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM) — Maharashtra

objective.value: Financial assistance / subsidy for procurement of agricultural equipment and farm machinery (tractors, rotavators, harvesters, etc.).

selection_mode.value: Computerized online lottery system conducted on MahaDBT portal for transparent allocation.

documents: Aadhaar Card and Caste certificate (if applicable for enhanced subsidy)
steps: Submit application on MahaDBT Farmer Schemes
Participate in district computer lottery draw
Purchase machinery upon receiving pre-sanction and upload invoice

summary_mr.text: ट्रॅक्टर, रोटाव्हेटर व इतर कृषी अवजारांच्या खरेदीसाठी अनुदान योजना. महाडीबीटी सोडत पद्धतीने निवड.

summary_hi.text: ट्रैक्टर, रोटावेटर और अन्य कृषि उपकरणों की खरीद पर सरकारी सहायता। महाडीबीटी लॉटरी द्वारा चयन।
